articles.headline: Dembélé, Torres star as PSG score 6 to launch UCL defense
articles.description: Ballon d'Or winner Ousmane Dembélé scored titleholder Paris Saint-Germain's first goals of the new Champions League campaign, and his first goals the season, when he netted twice in a 6-1 home win against Slovan Bratislava on Wednesday.

articles.headline: Liverpool vs. Atlético Madrid player ratings as Alexis Mac Allister scores the winner in Champions League comeback win
articles.description: Liverpool got their UEFA Champions league campaign off to the perfect start as they came from behind to beat Atlético Madrid 2-1 -- with goals from Dominik Szboszlai and Alexis Mac Allister.

articles.headline: Orioles put Alexander on IL; hope Henderson recovers quickly
articles.description: The Orioles have placed versatile Blaze Alexander on the 10-day injured list and are hopeful that shortstop Gunnar Henderson can recover quickly from a knee injury that left him out of the starting lineup Wednesday night against Cleveland.

articles.headline: Henry Bolte's homer in the 4th inning helps Athletics beat Blue Jays 2-0
articles.description: — Henry Bolte hit a solo home run in the third inning and Tyler White scored on a wild pitch as the Athletics beat the Toronto Blue Jays 2-0 on Wednesday.

articles.headline: Colt Keith homers as young Tigers lineup beats struggling Twins, 7-2
articles.description: — Colt Keith homered and the Detroit Tigers ended a seven-series losing streak with a 7-2 win over the Minnesota Twins on Wednesday afternoon.

articles.headline: Martin Ødegaard nets late winner as Arsenal beat Napoli
articles.description: Martin Ødegaard's fine second-half goal saw Arsenal kick off their Champions League campaign with a 1-0 win at Napoli on Wednesday.

articles.headline: Yankees placing 2B Jazz Chisholm on IL with sprained thumb
articles.description: The Yankees are placing second baseman Jazz Chisholm Jr. on the injured list with a sprained right thumb, manager Aaron Boone announced Wednesday.

articles.headline: Paris Saint-Germain launch UCL defense with 6-goal rout of Slovan
articles.description: Ferran Torres scored a hat trick as Paris Saint-Germain swept aside Slovan Bratislava to start the defence of their European crown with a 6-1 win.

articles.description: The Lakers are hiring longtime Miami Heat executive Eric Amsler as an assistant general manager, sources told ESPN's Shams Charania on Wednesday.

articles.description: Liverpool could make a bid to sign Crystal Palace's Adam Wharton as soon as January. Transfer Talk has the latest.

articles.headline: Tottenham's Mykhailo Mudryk out until at least October with ankle injury - sources"
articles.description: Mykhailo Mudryk is set to be sidelined until October at the earliest after suffering an ankle injury in training, sources have told ESPN.

articles.headline: EuroLeague sets Oct. 5 to vote on role in NBA Europe project
articles.description: EuroLeague owners are set to meet on Oct. 5 in Milan, Italy to discuss whether to accept the NBA proposal and allow the league to be absorbed into NBA Europe or continue to operate as a separate league.
